SBI VC Trade distributes RLUSD under Japan Type 4 classification; SBI Ripple Asia's MoneyTap/XRPL tokenized-deposit work is a concept proof, not production XRP bridge use.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Open interest has contracted from the early-November high in Liqwall's own daily series, but cross-provider totals are not comparable without aligned venue and contract scope.
support: Liqwall same-provider daily OI declined about 35.0% from Nov 4 to Nov 16; current intraday OI is $954M and down 3.6% in 24h.
disconfirming_or_limiting: BitcoinLeverage covers only 2 of 22 contracts; TradRadar is one day older and uses seven exchanges; OptimistFi search/page mismatch is quarantined.
Long account ratios on Binance and Bybit remain high, while funding is negative; account counts are not notional exposure.
tests: Capture all exchange OI contracts with source timestamps and normalize one-side/two-side conventions.
Reconcile venue coverage and contract identifiers before computing a market-wide total.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The sampled Fuelmaps book was bid-skewed inside 1%, but the snapshot is stale and incomplete.
support: Fuelmaps 1% band showed $11.6M bids versus $8.4M asks.
disconfirming_or_limiting: Snapshot age is 89m24s; Binance and Bitget are absent; resting orders can cancel; only four venues supply full depth.
tests: Capture synchronized raw L2 snapshots and executed trades.
Measure order cancellations, replenishment and realized slippage.

competing_hypotheses.claim: November 16 XRP ETF flow remains unresolved because one tracker is partial and the broader tracker uses a different fund universe with an aggregate AUM inconsistency.
support: CryptoKeyhole partial -5.197M XRP at 2/4 daily funds.
XRP Insights broader +158K XRP at 6 spot plus BITW.
disconfirming_or_limiting: The sources have different universes; XRP Insights excludes GXRP from flow totals and its aggregate AUM fields fail internal arithmetic reconciliation.
tests: Fetch issuer holdings, NAV, shares and net assets for every fund at the same valuation date.
Keep partial days separate; do not infer total flow until all issuer files are present.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase, Circle and PNC report substantial USDC distribution and payments activity, but those rails do not establish XRP purchases, XRP bridge use or XRPL settlement.
support: Coinbase RLUSD distribution; PNC/Coinbase USDC pilot on Ethereum; Circle's Q3 USDC scale and payment-rail expansion; SBI VC Trade RLUSD distribution.
disconfirming_or_limiting: None of the announced PNC flows use XRP; RLUSD collateral on Coinbase Global Exchange was not live at launch; SBI's XRPL deposit work is a concept proof.
tests: Measure XRP-specific bridge volume, exchange flows, collateral balances and settlement transactions attributable to these integrations.
Verify production status, not announcements or pilots.

disconfirming_or_limiting: Handle mismatch; no official cross-link; direct YouTube channel fetch throttled.

data_quality.raw_receipt_policy: A rendered page, search snippet, GitHub artifact ZIP digest or repository commit hash is not a byte-exact external publisher receipt. All new records retain null raw_content_sha256/raw_source_sha256.
data_quality.feature_admission_policy: Research-only; exclude from point-in-time feature store until byte-exact source capture, receipt metadata, publisher timestamp validation, source lineage and quality controls pass.
